project.name: surgidoc
project.objective: SurgiDoc: an endoscopy documentation assistant per Architecture Flowchart.png (EndoViT frame description, RAG over TigerCloud, LangGraph orchestration with generator and judge agents using Google AI Studio free models, guardrails, human approval, PDF report, Redis cache, observability). Dataset from Kaggle. Secrets in a local keys txt file. Maintain a decisions MD file consulted before decisions. Test cases for everything.

assumptions.text: Voyage multimodal-3.x free allowance (200M text tokens) is from a third-party page and free trial is 3 RPM / 10K TPM without payment method; Cohere trial limits unverified. Verify before committing.
Gemini free tier may use content for product improvement; acceptable only because data is public.

invariants.text: Whenever work needs TigerCloud (or any service credential: Redis, Google AI Studio, Kaggle, Voyage, Cohere, EndoVIT endpoint), STOP and ask the user in chat to fill the matching keys.txt entries (TIGERCLOUD_SERVICE_URL, TIGERCLOUD_DB_PASSWORD, ...). Never invent values; code must raise MissingKey naming the entry.

decisions.title: Gemini-only LLMs via Google AI Studio
decisions.text: All agent LLM calls (generator, judge) use Gemini free-tier models via Google AI Studio API. No OpenRouter/GPT/Claude. Embedding: Voyage multimodal + Cohere rerank only if free tier verified at implementation time, else gemini-embedding-001.

decisions.title: Data: public only, human approval mandatory
decisions.text: Only public datasets (Kaggle newslab/cholecseg8k via kagglehub, plus public EU/Germany-focused endoscopy surgery text) are used. No real patient data. Every generated report requires human approval; output is a draft, never a diagnosis.

decisions.title: Scope: all layers, production/enterprise grade, Python
decisions.text: Build every layer in Architecture Flowchart.png (RAG, LangGraph generator/judge, guardrails, gateway, human approval, PDF, TigerCloud+Redis, observability, security/governance). Python, LangGraph, pytest, tests for every component. Secrets in git-ignored keys.txt. DECISIONS.md consulted before every decision.

decisions.title: EndoViT runs remotely, not on local CPU
decisions.text: User CPU is weak. EndoViT inference must go through a free hosted option (to be found; none confirmed). Frame-description sits behind an interface so a Gemini-vision fallback is possible.

decisions.title: MIMIC-IV-Note rejected; licence limits on KB sources
decisions.text: MIMIC-IV-Note rejected (credentialed DUA, patient notes, US ICU). ESGE KB papers are CC BY-NC(-ND) and CholecT45/CAMMA CC BY-NC-SA: non-commercial prototype only. 4 of 6 ESGE papers are Cascade guidelines for resource-limited settings, not full ESGE guidelines.

decisions.title: Embeddings: gemini-embedding-001 default, dim 768
decisions.text: Docs (ai.google.dev, 2026-10-26): gemini-embedding-2 is multimodal but aggregates a batch into ONE embedding and has no task_type, so text RAG defaults to gemini-embedding-001 (batch, taskType, we L2-normalize truncated dims). Model/dim configurable; revisit embedding-2 for frame/image search. Voyage/Cohere not used until free limits verified. Tiger Cloud: pg_textsearch BM25 (<@>) + pgvectorscale diskann + RRF k=60.

decisions.title: Vision: Gemini vision default, EndoViT optional via endpoint contract
decisions.text: EndoViT is an MAE-pretrained encoder (feature backbone), not a captioner, and no free hosted EndoViT endpoint was found. FrameDescriber interface: EndoViTClient (ENDOVIT_INFERENCE_URL/TOKEN, contract POST {image_b64,mime} -> {findings,labels}) is tried first when configured; Gemini vision (gateway role 'vision', batched frames per request to save free-tier quota) is the working default and fallback. Frame extraction via opencv-python-headless (no ffmpeg here).

decisions.title: T07 agent design: cited statements, fail-closed judge, bounded loop
decisions.text: LangGraph StateGraph retrieve->generate->(citation check)->judge->{approved|regenerate|stop}. Generator returns JSON statements each citing source ids (F<n> frame findings, K<n> KB chunks); uncited or unknown-id statements are rejected deterministically before the judge call (saves free-tier quota, enforces NFR-3). Judge (different model than generator) returns {approved, issues, feedback}; unparseable judge output = NOT approved (fail closed). Max attempts bounded (default 3); result status approved|rejected|blocked; always labelled draft. KB text and findings are wrapped as data in tags; system prompt says they are not instructions (prompt injection).

decisions.title: T09: approver self-named, fpdf2 core fonts (latin-1), Postgres tables with hypertable events
decisions.text: Approver types their own name in the name field (user is the approver); recorded as given, no authentication until T10 RBAC. Approval binds to a sha256 content hash; edits (re-checked by guardrails) reset approval; edit after approval is refused; final PDF only from an approved, hash-verified item (AC-3). PDF via fpdf2 core Helvetica: characters outside latin-1 are replaced with '?' (known ceiling, upgrade = bundle a TTF). Storage: <prefix>_reports (jsonb + bytea pdf), <prefix>_events (hypertable on at), <prefix>_rollups; parameterized SQL; prefix whitelisted.

decisions.title: T10 security design: keys.txt user registry, RBAC with separation of duties, hash-chained audit, AES-GCM primitives
decisions.text: Users live in keys.txt as SURGIDOC_USERS=Name:role+role;Name2:role (git-ignored, no new files). Roles: reviewer (view/edit/approve/reject), operator (run pipeline/view), admin (audit view/users manage/view) - admin and operator cannot approve (separation of duties). GuardedReview binds approver name to the authenticated user and audits every allow/deny; denials are audited (AC-7). Audit log: append-only, sha256 hash-chained, redacts secret-like keys, verify() + external head anchor detects truncation; Tiger Cloud sink uses advisory lock + DB triggers forbidding UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE. Crypto: AES-256-GCM, versioned envelope with key fingerprint, AAD binds ciphertext to record id, optional previous key for rotation. KNOWN GAP: ReportStore (T09, closed) stores plaintext jsonb/pdf; applying encryption to stored columns needs a later task (plan reopen). No real authentication (no passwords/login) - registry is name->roles only.

decisions.title: Accepted risk: Redis without TLS (free tier)
decisions.text: User's free Redis account offers no rediss:// TLS endpoint; the project uses the plain redis:// URL (user decision 2026-10-26). Consequences: the Redis password and cached values cross the network unencrypted, so use only on trusted networks. Mitigations already in place: cache keys are SHA-256 hashes, only public-data values are cached, cache fails open. compliance check 'redis-tls' will therefore report FAIL; this is an accepted, documented exception, to be revisited if a TLS endpoint or paid plan becomes available. Do not cache anything other than public data.

decisions.title: T13: encryption at rest design, packaging guard, PDF cited sources
decisions.text: ReportStore(cipher=...): statements, sources and pdf columns are bytea AES-GCM envelopes (AAD = report id + column), explicit 'encrypted' flag per row, event details replaced by {encrypted: b64} (AAD = report id + type + revision); approver name, content hash, event type/actor/time stay plaintext for queryability and audit. Read verifies the content hash (second layer against column swapping). build_pipeline REQUIRES SURGIDOC_ENCRYPTION_KEY. PDF Sources section lists only cited sources in first-citation order; hash still covers all sources. pyproject declares runtime deps with lower bounds + extras (dev, kaggle, ocr); tests/test_packaging.py fails if any third-party import lacks a declared dependency or an optional lib is imported at module level. NOT done: clean-venv install test (WSL memory), encryption of existing rows (none exist), key rotation procedure beyond SURGIDOC_ENCRYPTION_KEY_PREVIOUS.

knowledge.title: Gemini free-tier models and limits
knowledge.text: ai.google.dev pricing (2026-10-26): free of charge input/output for gemini-2.5-flash, 2.5-flash-lite, 3.6-flash, 3.5-flash-lite, 3.1-flash-lite. Per-model RPM/TPM/RPD are NOT published on the rate-limits page (view in AI Studio); limits are per project, RPD resets midnight Pacific, 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED on breach. Free tier content may be used to improve products: public data only. Gateway: configurable routes+limits, conservative defaults, 429 is ground truth.

knowledge.title: Live check: pg_textsearch needs to_bm25query
knowledge.text: On Tiger Cloud (PG18, pg_textsearch), 'ORDER BY content <@> %s' with a bound parameter fails: 'no BM25 index found for text <@> text expression'. Working form: ORDER BY content <@> to_bm25query(%s, 'chunks_bm25_idx'). PgStore.setup/add/vector verified live; chunk ids currently embed absolute file paths (ingest source) and should be made relative.
